text: Acceptance 5: thread-edit focus still fails when SSE precedes the PATCH response. In-memory ui-t16-chat repro using the real thread renderer: edit root 10, press Enter, deliver its message_updated SSE event, then resolve PATCH 200. Output: saved='thread edit saved', focused='body'; expected 'th-input'. SSE removes the editor before hadFocus is checked. Preserve focus ownership across background redraws while respecting deliberate user focus changes.
